name: omnilab/launches
description: Omnilab Launches: orbital launches of The Space Devs' Launch Library 2, past and planned - a launch by id (rocket, provider, mission and orbit, pad and its place, date and its precision, window, status, probability, failure), a search by text, and the launches of a period as occurrences, each with its time and its pad's place, filtered by provider, rocket, location, crew, status or orbit; no key needed (15 calls an hour).
